action_items: MOVE the Roster trophy-room tab logic from /app/frontend/src/pages/RosterPage.jsx into the actually-routed component (likely /app/frontend/src/lovable/pages/Team.tsx — referenced as LovableTeam in App.js:98). MOVE the Crown icon link from /app/frontend/src/pages/TradeBlockPage.jsx into /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/TradeBlock.tsx (rendered for /trade-block via LovableTradeBlock, App.js:104). Re-add trade-block-trophy-link-{teamId} on each item with team_id.
After moving, re-run the iter51 Playwright validation: standings crown count > 0, trade-block crown count > 0, roster trophy room tab/link visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Two parallel page implementations exist (lovable/* vs pages/*Page.jsx). The non-routed *Page.jsx files create maintenance hazard — every future enhancement risks being applied to the wrong file (as happened here). Recommend either deleting the unused pages/{Roster,Standings,TradeBlock}Page.jsx files OR routing them and removing the lovable duplicates.

Backend GET /api/trade-block (no league_id filter) returns ~5 of 43 items with team_id=null. The frontend calls it without league_id, but the page only shows items for the active league (visual filter). Crown rendering checks `item.team_id` so historical items missing team_id silently skip the crown — acceptable degraded behavior but worth backfilling team_id on legacy items.

DynastyCareerChart renders inside a fixed-height container (h-72) — initial mount produces a one-shot Recharts width/height(-1) warning. Wrap in a deferred mount or pass explicit width/height to ResponsiveContainer to silence the warning.

rca of the issue: The frontend has two parallel implementations of these pages: /app/frontend/src/pages/{Roster,Standings,TradeBlock}Page.jsx (NOT routed) and /app/frontend/src/lovable/{pages,components}/{Team,Standings,TradeBlock}.tsx (the actually-routed components, registered in App.js as LovableTeam/LovableStandings/LovableTradeBlock). The main agent applied the new Crown icons + Trophy Room tabs to the non-routed *Page.jsx files. Verification: rendered DOM shows x-file-name="TradeBlock" attribute on the live trade-block DOM (confirmed via JS evaluate); App.js explicitly imports LovableTeam/Standings/TradeBlock and routes /roster, /standings, /trade-block to those. Reproduction: log in as chriszarek and visit each page — none of the new testids render. Mitigation: re-apply the changes inside the lovable/* counterpart files and remove the dead *Page.jsx (or route them and remove the lovable copies).
